best_idea: Send the last three input frames in every packet and, on a gap, replay the real missed frames before the newest one, so a single lost packet costs no movement and no ordering error.
decision_why: Keep the three-frame redundancy, the repeat-last catch-up and the cut-off, but run one fixed server tick per frame; the donor trusts client msec up to 0.1 s per command, which breaks server-verified kills and speed rules.
acceptance: A server test sends packets with seq 1-3 then seq 7 and asserts the frames run are [repeat of frame 3, frame 5, frame 6, frame 7] in order; 20 or more lost frames run only the newest; a duplicate packet runs nothing; a client cannot make the server run more than one frame per tick.
